name: Browser Tools
description: Host-neutral Agent browser loop with structured snapshots, ref actions, tabs, downloads, PDF, emulation, cookie/storage inspection, request details, vault sign-in and extensions across the embedded preview, local Chromium, your own Chrome and the cloud browser.
author: cognia-next

browser.reason: The embedded preview and local Chromium exist only in the desktop app. In a browser tab the tools work only while the remote Chromium engine is enabled and healthy; otherwise each call returns a browser_feature_unsupported error.

mobile.reason: The mobile app has no embedded preview or local Chromium. The tools drive the remote Chromium engine of a paired desktop or cloud host and return a browser_feature_unsupported error when it is not enabled and healthy.
